description: This file defines a utility struct 'RecordedConnectionIssue' used for recording, resolving, and delaying retries for connection issues within the Orleans event sourcing framework. It includes methods for recording issues, resolving them, delaying before retries, and converting the issue to a string.

classes.name: RecordedConnectionIssue
classes.description: A struct for tracking and managing connection issues, including recording new issues, resolving existing ones, and handling retry delays.

methods.name: Record
methods.description: Records a new connection issue, updates timestamps, failure counts, and notifies the listener.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves the current issue, notifies the listener, and clears the issue.

methods.name: DelayBeforeRetry
methods.description: Asynchronously delays execution based on the retry delay of the current issue.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current issue, or an empty string if none.
